name: Living Together Unmarried
overview: Scripture clearly defines the sanctity of marriage as a divinely ordained union where a man and woman become one flesh, as established in Genesis 2:24. The law's authority over a person persists throughout their life, underscoring the seriousness of marital commitment (Romans 7:1). Living together unmarried falls short of God's design and aligns with the works of the flesh, such as fornication and uncleanness, which Scripture condemns (Galatians 5:19). Hebrews 13:4 affirms that marriage is honorable and the marital bed undefiled, warning that God will judge those who engage in sexual immorality outside of this covenant.
